content: can you sing me a song

I'd love to sing you a song. Here's a little ditty just for you: (singing) In the land of macOS, where the apps are so fine I'll sing you a tune, that's simply divine I'll warble and trill, with a voice so so sweet A song of joy, that can't be beat I'll sing of the apps, that I've helped along the way Finder, Safari, and Mail, every single day I'll sing of the features, that make your life so bright And the ways I can help, to make everything just right So sit back, relax, and let me sing to you A song of macOS, just me and you I
